text:
Dana Park: :rotating_light: incident-bot flagged GPU pool 'gpu-eu-west-1' at 92% utilization and request queue > 8000. Seeing elevated 503s and timeouts.
incident-bot: [ALERT] GPU_POOL_SATURATION gpu-eu-west-1 utilization=92 queue=8123 503_rate=14% link: https://redwood.inc/ops/incident/1819876543
Ravi Singh: I'm paged, joining now... what's the customer impact?
Priya Kapoor: Confirming customer reports — multiple generation calls failing (AcmeCorp, BetaHealth). Telemetry shows ingest latency >5s and token throughput down ~60%.
Logan Chen: Checking autoscaler logs, looks like recent scale-up attempts failed with quota errors.
Dana Park: Can someone run `redwoodctl pool describe gpu-eu-west-1 --since 10m` and paste output?
Ravi Singh: Pasting relevant block:
```
$ redwoodctl pool describe gpu-eu-west-1 --since 10m
Pool: gpu-eu-west-1
Desired: 40
Actual: 40
PendingScaleUp: 8
ScaleStatus: FAILED
Error: quotaExceeded: requested 8, available 0
Autoscaler v2.3.1: failed to create nodes
```
Priya Kapoor: Autoscaler tried to add nodes but hit cloud GPU quota. So the root cause is capacity but autoscaler unable to remediate. Immediate mitigations we should do: 1) throttle non-critical tenants, 2) enable model fallback to smaller variants, 3) spill critical traffic to reserved capacity in us-east-1.
Ravi Singh: I'll apply tenant throttles and enable fallbacks for noisy tenants. Executing now.
Ravi Singh: `redwoodctl routing update --selector 'tenant in (nonpaying,test)' --throttle 10rps`
Dana Park: Throttles applied. Noncritical queue dropped from ~5k to ~900 in the first 30s.
Logan Chen: Initiating cross-region spillover for critical traffic: `redwoodctl route spillover --from gpu-eu-west-1 --to gpu-us-east-1 --tenants 'critical'`
incident-bot: Spillover started; estimated cutover ~60s.
Priya Kapoor: Also pushing model variant change for large-generation workloads: set variant `small-q4` fallback for cost/throughput.
Ravi Singh: Confirmed fallback applied for AcmeCorp. Token consumption reduced ~2.8x, error rate down to ~1.2%.
Dana Park: Queue stabilized to ~700, overall GPU utilization down to ~78%. Good sign.
Logan Chen: Cloud support: autoscaler attempted node creation but cloud returned `quotaExceeded`. Can someone open an urgent support case for GPU quota?
Cloud Team: Support case opened P1 #INC-78912. Estimated response/quota update ~2 hours.
Priya Kapoor: We should keep spillover and throttles until quota is resolved. Rampdown criteria: queue <200 sustained for 15m, error rate <1%.
Ravi Singh: On-call timeline: I'm staying on for the next 30m with live monitoring. Will hand off once stable.
Dana Park: Sending customer comms now: "We are experiencing degraded performance in EU. We've applied throttles, model fallbacks, and cross-region spillover to mitigate. We're working with cloud support on a quota increase. Next update in 30m." :memo:
incident-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2; incident doc created https://redwood.inc/ops/incident/1819876543
Logan Chen: After ~25m, queue steady ~160, error rate ~0.5%. Looks stable enough to consider reverting some mitigations.
Ravi Singh: Preparing handoff to Priya for extended monitoring. I'll be available for another hour if anything regresses. @Priya Kapoor please take lead.
Priya Kapoor: Taking over. Immediate action items: 1) Draft postmortem (lead), 2) Follow up on quota case, 3) Update autoscaler runbook and alerting to detect `quotaRejected` earlier.
Dana Park: +1 to runbook update. Add an automated spillover script to the runbook (one-command failover).
Priya Kapoor: Final status update: queue <100 for 20m, errors back to baseline. Reverting throttles and model fallbacks for critical tenants in 5m.
Ravi Singh: Reversion commands executed, verified critical tenants on standard variants.
Dana Park: Incident resolved at 1819876840. Summary: autoscaler blocked by cloud GPU quota -> queue growth -> customer-facing 503s/timeouts. Mitigations: tenant throttles, model fallback, cross-region spillover. No data loss, reduced customer impact.
Priya Kapoor: Postmortem owners: Priya (lead), Logan (autoscaler changes), Ravi (runbook & comms). Deliverables: postmortem draft EOD, runbook MR for `quotaRejected` path, OPS ticket for scripted spillover.
incident-bot: Incident closed. Created follow-ups: OPS-556 (spillover runbook), MR-422 (runbook update), INC-78912 (cloud quota case).
